title: Core Atmosphere Sequence
description: A four-image reference-driven sequence that establishes the canonical atmosphere and three controlled dependent variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 sets the authoritative light logic, spatial identity, and emotional temperature; images 02-04 must remain inside the same world while changing camera distance, angle, or dramatic emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-closer-frame, 03-spatial-counterpoint, 04-climax-frame. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
